content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Payment gateway

A no-KYC payment gateway is a transaction processor that does not require identity verification for either the merchant or the buyer. NOWPayments, for example, accepts 300+ cryptocurrencies with a flat 0.5% fee. Compare this to Gumroad’s 10% fee structure. On a $97 product sold 100 times monthly, Gumroad extracts $9,700 in fees. NOWPayments retains $485. You keep $921 more. This is not a workaround—it’s base-layer infrastructure. No platform stands between you and your customer. No account can be suspended. No region is off-limits. The stack integrates hosting, backend logic, order storage, and file delivery into a single system you own outright.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The sovereign commerce stack uses GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for static hosting (free). Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend logic like order processing and file delivery (free). Supabase or Google Sheets store order data (free). NOWPayments verifies crypto payments via webhook, triggering instant product delivery. For example, a customer buys a $97 ebook using USDT on the TRON network. NOWPayments confirms the transaction on-chain, sends a webhook to your backend, and the ebook is delivered via a secure, expiring Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 link. The entire process bypasses centralized payment processors. You control every component. No platform fees. No KYC. No buyer account required.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is for digital creators in regions where conventional payment processors are restricted or unreliable. Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Ethiopia, Venezuela, Zimbabwe, Cameroon, Tanzania, and the Philippines are prime examples. If you sell ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, or software, this stack gives you direct access to global customers. It’s also for creators who reject platform dependency. Gumroad, Payhip, and Paddle lock you into their ecosystems. This stack deploys on infrastructure you own. No subscriptions. No platform rules. Lifetime access. Built for creators who value sovereignty over convenience.
NOWPayments charges 0.5% per transaction. Gumroad charges 10%. Retain $921 more on 100 sales of a $97 product.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The stack consists of five core components: (1) Hosting: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for static site deployment. (2) Backend Logic: Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for order processing and file delivery. (3) Order Storage: Supabase or Google Sheets for transaction records. (4) File Delivery: Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for secure, expiring download links. (5) Payment Processing: NOWPayments for crypto payments with automatic webhook integration. Each component is free or low-cost. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides all blueprints and templates to deploy this stack in 48 hours. No coding required. Full ownership after deployment. COREMERCH has no access to your infrastructure post-delivery.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start by choosing your stack: Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) for basic deployments or Edge Commerce Stack ($197) for advanced features like SPF/DKIM/DMARC email configuration. Alternatively, purchase the Complete Builder Kit ($197) for all blueprints and templates. Deploy on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto processing. Load your products and test end-to-end. The stack is live within 48 hours. No platform dependencies. No KYC. Full data ownership. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to begin. Built in Zimbabwe. Pressure-tested against payment rejection, currency collapse, and financial isolation. Infrastructure sovereignty—not rented, owned.

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, deploy a sovereign commerce stack using GitHub Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for crypto processing. This setup bypasses centralized payment processors and platform fees. For example, a creator in Kenya can sell a $47 ebook globally using USDT on the BSC network. NOWPayments verifies the payment, triggers a webhook, and delivers the ebook via a secure Google Drive link. No platform takes a cut. No KYC required. Full ownership of the infrastructure.
